metadata.rustc:
rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28)
binary: rustc
commit-hash: b940084d7eb6a299eb4bfeb8e34901bc051e7ac4
commit-date: 2026-09-28
host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
release: 1.99.0
LLVM version: 23.1.1

features.criterion: default (napi), plus core test-hooks dev feature

limitations: Finite representative workloads, not full code coverage.
No CPU affinity or isolation; compare on the same quiet machine.
Criterion samples are per-iteration batch averages. Scheduler and trusted samples are independent whole-run summary medians, not per-call samples.
Trusted process measurement uses the current emitted TypeScript sources, including any dirty edits.
LanguageService cases use the NAPI binding; LSP transport is built and fingerprinted but not measured.
No filesystem/network runtime, wasm, Bun, or native trusted-process workload measured.
